title: Server-Side Game Developer
description: Master multiplayer backend engineering: authoritative game servers, low-latency UDP protocols, spatial partitioning, lag compensation, matchmaking, Agones Kubernetes orchestration, Redis state, and anti-cheat.

phases.title: Network & Physics Foundations
phases.focus: Dedicated Servers, Reliable UDP, Binary Delta Compression & Spatial Partitioning Grids

phases.title: State Authority & Orchestration
phases.focus: Server Physics Reconciliation, Lag Rewind, Matchmaking MMR, Agones K8s & Redis Presence

phases.title: Anti-Cheat, Scale & LiveOps
phases.focus: Anti-Cheat Validation, In-Game Chat, Dynamic LiveOps, Telemetry & Headless Bot Testing

phases.title: Global Infrastructure Capstone
phases.focus: Zero-Downtime Fleets, Multi-Region Anycast Routing, and Multiplayer Backend Capstone

nodes.title: Server-Side Game Architecture Foundations
nodes.subtitle: Dedicated vs listen servers, authoritative vs peer-to-peer, tick rates, fixed timestep updates
learning_objectives: Contrast dedicated authoritative server topologies with peer-to-peer lockstep models
Configure a deterministic server tick loop running at fixed simulation intervals (e.g. 64Hz)
feynman_prompts: Why do competitive multiplayer games always rely on dedicated authoritative servers?
key_misconceptions: Allowing game clients to execute authoritative game simulation logic

nodes.title: Low-Latency Game Networking (UDP, TCP & WebSockets)
nodes.subtitle: Transport protocols, UDP packet reliability layers, packet loss handling, header overhead, MTU
learning_objectives: Build custom reliable-UDP sequencing and acknowledgment protocols over raw UDP sockets
Explain why TCP head-of-line blocking makes standard TCP unsuitable for fast-action games
feynman_prompts: What is Head-of-Line blocking in TCP and how does UDP avoid it?
key_misconceptions: Using HTTP REST APIs for real-time multiplayer combat synchronization

nodes.title: Binary Serialization & Network Bandwidth Optimization
nodes.subtitle: Bit packing, delta compression, Protobuf, FlatBuffers, quantization, bandwidth budgeting
learning_objectives: Quantize floating-point vector coordinates into compact integers to reduce packet payloads
Implement delta compression transmitting only mutated entity components per tick
feynman_prompts: Why is sending raw JSON over sockets unacceptable for high-frequency game server ticks?
key_misconceptions: Sending full entity transforms every tick instead of compressed delta states

nodes.title: Spatial Partitioning & Area of Interest (AoI)
nodes.subtitle: Grid hashing, quadtrees, octrees, area of interest management, entity filtering
learning_objectives: Implement 2D grid hashing and quadtrees to broadcast updates only to relevant nearby players
Filter out-of-vision server snapshots to reduce both server CPU and network egress
feynman_prompts: Explain how spatial hashing prevents an O(N^2) entity broadcast explosion in dense game worlds.
key_misconceptions: Broadcasting every entity's position to every connected player across the entire map

nodes.title: Server Authoritative Physics & Reconciliation
nodes.subtitle: Simulating physics server-side, inputs queue, server tick snapshots, rollback reconciliation
learning_objectives: Execute deterministic gameplay physics on the server decoupled from graphical rendering
Validate sequence numbers and generate authoritative state snapshots for client rollback
feynman_prompts: How does server authority prevent speed hacks and position teleportation cheats?
key_misconceptions: Simulating physics only on client machines and letting the server passively trust results

nodes.title: Lag Compensation & Server Time-Rewind
nodes.subtitle: Hit registration, server history buffer, rewinding player hitboxes, ping advantage mitigation
learning_objectives: Implement server-side lag compensation by rewinding target hitboxes to the client's fire timestamp
Cap maximum rewind thresholds to prevent extreme 'getting shot around walls' experiences
feynman_prompts: Explain step-by-step how an authoritative server validates a sniper hit from a 100ms ping player.
key_misconceptions: Rewinding server history indefinitely, which penalizes low-ping players

nodes.title: Matchmaking Systems & Skill Rating Algorithms
nodes.subtitle: Elo, Glicko-2, TrueSkill, matchmaking queues, ticket expansion, ping vs skill balancing
learning_objectives: Implement rating update algorithms (Elo/Glicko) and queue expansion rules
Balance queue wait times against latency and skill rating variance
feynman_prompts: Why do matchmaking systems gradually widen MMR search radius over queue wait duration?
key_misconceptions: Matching players strictly on level/playtime rather than latent skill rating

nodes.title: Dedicated Game Server Orchestration (Agones & K8s)
nodes.subtitle: Agones on Kubernetes, fleet scaling, game server lifecycles (Allocated, Ready, Shutdown)
learning_objectives: Deploy containerized game server binaries on Kubernetes using Google Agones
Manage game server allocation requests from matchmakers without killing active matches
feynman_prompts: How does Agones prevent Kubernetes from terminating a container with an active 40-minute match?
key_misconceptions: Treating stateful dedicated game servers as stateless microservices

nodes.title: Player Sessions & Ephemeral State with Redis
nodes.subtitle: Presence tracking, active match routing, distributed locks, session tokens, heartbeat timeouts
learning_objectives: Manage global player presence and active game server routing tables using Redis
Implement distributed locks and heartbeats to cleanly evict dropped player sessions
feynman_prompts: Why is an in-memory store like Redis required for matchmaking queues rather than relational DBs?
key_misconceptions: Relying on database polling every second to check player online status

nodes.title: Player Inventories, Economy & Transactional Databases
nodes.subtitle: ACID transactions, PostgreSQL, item minting, dupe glitch prevention, currency ledgers
learning_objectives: Design double-entry bookkeeping ledgers for virtual currencies preventing duplication glitches
Enforce strict database transactions with optimistic locking during item trades
feynman_prompts: Explain how asynchronous inventory saving can lead to item duplication during sudden server crashes.
key_misconceptions: Modifying player inventory balances without strict database row locks

nodes.title: Anti-Cheat Architecture & Server-Side Heuristics
nodes.subtitle: Heuristic anomaly detection, speed/teleport validation, aimbot statistical analysis, fog-of-war
learning_objectives: Implement server-side velocity clamping and geometric raycast validation to block wallhacks
Detect statistical anomalies in aimbot angular acceleration and impossible reaction times
feynman_prompts: Why is server-side validation the only foolproof defense against game memory manipulation?
key_misconceptions: Believing client-side anti-cheat software alone is enough to prevent cheating

nodes.title: In-Game Chat, Social Graphs & Voice Services
nodes.subtitle: Pub/Sub chat channels, profanity filtering, friend lists, party systems, WebRTC voice signaling
learning_objectives: Architect scalable real-time chat servers utilizing Redis Pub/Sub and Kafka
Manage party invites, presence notifications, and WebRTC voice channel handshakes
feynman_prompts: How do you route group voice packets efficiently without overloading the game simulation server?
key_misconceptions: Running audio encoding and voice streaming directly through the game tick server thread

nodes.title: LiveOps, Dynamic Configuration & Content Delivery
nodes.subtitle: Remote config, feature flags, hot patching game data, seasonal events, CDN asset bundles
learning_objectives: Build remote configuration systems to adjust weapon balance parameters without client updates
Distribute seasonal game asset bundles securely via global Content Delivery Networks (CDNs)
feynman_prompts: Why should game design balance parameters be dynamically configurable from the server?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding game balance values directly into compiled client executables

nodes.title: Game Telemetry, Logging & Analytics at Scale
nodes.subtitle: Event ingestion, Kafka, ClickHouse, kill heatmaps, retention funnels, combat balance telemetry
learning_objectives: Stream high-volume player gameplay telemetry events into Kafka and ClickHouse
Generate spatial heatmaps of player deaths and weapon usage to identify balance anomalies
feynman_prompts: Why is columnar storage (ClickHouse) optimal for analyzing billions of game telemetry events?
key_misconceptions: Logging high-frequency player movement events directly into the transactional inventory database

nodes.title: Load Testing Game Servers with Headless Bots
nodes.subtitle: Simulated virtual players, stress testing tick rates, simulating network jitter, benchmarking egress
learning_objectives: Build headless bot clients simulating hundreds of concurrent players firing and moving
Benchmark server CPU tick stability, memory allocation, and bandwidth under heavy combat
feynman_prompts: What metrics indicate that a game server tick loop is suffocating under load?
key_misconceptions: Testing server capacity with simple HTTP requests instead of realistic UDP socket simulations

nodes.title: Fleet Rolling Updates & Zero-Downtime Deployments
nodes.subtitle: Multi-version game client support, draining old fleets, Blue/Green game server migrations
learning_objectives: Coordinate fleet updates allowing older game clients to finish matches while new versions deploy
Drain game server instances gracefully without disrupting active matches
feynman_prompts: How do you manage client-server version compatibility when deploying a hotfix patch?
key_misconceptions: Force-terminating running game instances during a fleet software update

nodes.title: Global Multi-Region Architecture & Anycast Routing
nodes.subtitle: Edge routing, Anycast, minimizing player RTT, cross-region matchmaking, DDoS mitigation
learning_objectives: Deploy game server clusters across multiple global cloud regions with latency-based routing
Mitigate large-scale UDP amplification DDoS attacks targeting game server ports
feynman_prompts: How does Anycast DNS/BGP routing direct players to the closest physical server cluster?
key_misconceptions: Centralizing all dedicated servers in a single geographic data center for global players

nodes.title: Full Multiplayer Backend Architecture Capstone
nodes.subtitle: Complete stack: matchmaking, Agones fleet, dedicated UDP server, Redis state, inventory DB & liveops
learning_objectives: Architect and deploy a scalable, resilient backend infrastructure supporting real-time multiplayer games
Integrate automated matchmaking, container orchestration, server reconciliation, and telemetry pipelines
feynman_prompts: What are the key operational runbooks required for operating an online multiplayer game launch?
key_misconceptions: Launching an online game without capacity headroom, automated fleet scaling, or DDoS protection
